# minja

Vendored C++ Jinja template engine, used as the Issue #21 `ITemplateRuntime`
backend for executing model-package-supplied `chat_template` programs.

- Upstream: https://github.com/google/minja
- Files: `minja.hpp`, `chat-template.hpp`
- Fetched from commit: `021c2293c187789ef13d56c6cfd89c9b134fd80f` (2025-09-22)
- License: MIT (Copyright 2024 Google LLC) — see `LICENSE` in this directory
- Modifications: none; vendored verbatim

Do not hand-edit `minja.hpp` / `chat-template.hpp`. To update, re-fetch both
files from the same upstream paths at a chosen commit and update the commit
hash above.
